| [CLAIM-152](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-152.md) | Any individuation built on sufficiency is relative to the target it is sufficient for: fix the outcomes differently and a different partition wins, so no boundary drawn this way is universal | Dual-filed from [MOM-POS-001](https://github.com/dmarx/mathematics-of-meaning/blob/main/record/positions.d/POS-001.md) ([ADR-037](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-037.md)). A sufficient statistic is sufficient for a target Y, so every partition chosen as minimal sufficient inherits Y. MOM's example: fix the outcomes differently and "organism" wins instead of "animal". In this record it is the standing caution on every boundary criterion filed beside it ([CLAIM-154](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-154.md), [CLAIM-161](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-161.md)). It does not say boundaries are arbitrary, only that each is relative to a stated target. | Active |
| [CLAIM-153](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-153.md) | Failure of a self to hold together across contexts is a monodromy around a cycle of contexts: any two locally consistent contexts glue, and the minimal model of the obstruction needs three | Dual-filed from [MOM-CLM-165](https://github.com/dmarx/mathematics-of-meaning/blob/main/record/claims.d/CLM-165.md) ([ADR-037](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-037.md)). Model contexts (roles, personas, sub-agents) as a cover, and the offsets that reconcile neighbours as a cochain. The frustrated XY or Kuramoto energy finds the obstruction: its minimum is 0 exactly when Φ ≡ 0. Abelian case only; re-checked here. | Active |
| [CLAIM-154](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-154.md) | A candidate structure is worth naming as a unit when its effect-to-noise ratio outruns the Occam cost of keeping it: reify when d'² exceeds the log prior-to-posterior variance ratio | Dual-filed from [MOM-CLM-160](https://github.com/dmarx/mathematics-of-meaning/blob/main/record/claims.d/CLM-160.md) ([ADR-037](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-037.md)). | [CLAIM-161](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-161.md) | A system persists as the same self over an interval when a coherence measure is approximately conserved along its own trajectory, not merely matched by some map between its states | Dual-filed from [MOM-CLM-153](https://github.com/dmarx/mathematics-of-meaning/blob/main/record/claims.d/CLM-153.md) ([ADR-037](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-037.md)). The corpus's selfhood condition, that some map φ preserves a coherence score γ, is satisfied by any two systems with similar scores. | [CLAIM-164](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-164.md) | What a spectral gap makes definite is the subspace of the cluster it isolates, not a single direction: the gap picks the object, and the object is a vector only when its own gap is wide | Dual-filed from [MOM-CLM-144](https://github.com/dmarx/mathematics-of-meaning/blob/main/record/claims.d/CLM-144.md) ([ADR-037](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-037.md)). Under a perturbation δT, the subspace spanned by a cluster of singular values separated by a gap δ rotates by at most ‖δT‖/δ (Davis–Kahan), whatever happens to the vectors inside it. So the well-defined unit is the gap-isolated projector. Re-measured here. With [CLAIM-154](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-154.md) it is a criterion: the gap picks the object, and the Occam factor says whether the gap is big enough. | Active |

| [CLAIM-196](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-196.md) | A person's roles in contexts that do not meet cannot contradict one another: role conflict needs an overlap, which segregating audiences prevents and collapsed contexts create | The MoM manuscript models a person's roles ("daughter", "teacher", "friend") as sections over family, professional and social contexts, with identity as their global section, failing when the roles contradict. Roles in contexts that do not meet glue ([CLAIM-197](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-197.md)), so contradiction between them is not yet a failure. Conflict needs an overlap: an occasion on which two audiences are present at once. People manage the cover. They segregate audiences, which keeps the contexts disjoint, and they script the occasions where audiences must meet. Broadcast and networked media collapse contexts, which creates overlaps the person did not choose (boyd 2008, after Meyrowitz 1985). | Proposed |
